label: diffuse; weak preference for step after early e, late steps of long sequences
explanation: Active on ~1% of steps spread over every phase, position and token, with no single token or position rule. Weak enrichments only: input right after e (6x, about 18% of mass), input 1 (4.4x), outputs m/t/i/p (4-5x), late original-phase positions in length 8-9 sequences (orig_idx 8 at 6x), and copy steps right after <DEL>. Never active at t=0. The best simple predicate (early original step right after e) reaches dev F1 0.13. Other predicates scored: prev_tok e alone, prev e or input 1, the output-token set, late positions, and input 1 in the copy phase. All had F1 at or below 0.13 and mass recall at or below 0.34. Magnitude is not captured by any of these.
